title: Exit teardown trusts one balance read at one confirmation, so a reorg of the sell block leaves a held position torn down

evidence.note: teardown unsubscribes anti-rug, deletes exit_state and clears timers, all irreversible within the process
codex (22-27 independent second opinion, graded S1): Unfinalized balances trigger irreversible monitoring teardown

sibling_sites_checked: Every teardown decision (:841-846, :984-992, :1099-1105, :1143-1157) reads balanceOf once at the node head. No confirmation depth or later re-check exists in the slice.
severity_rationale: S3: reorgs deep enough to drop a mined sell are rare on the four chains; if one happens the position is held with no monitor or anti-rug.
recommendation: Re-check the balance after a few blocks before the irreversible teardown, or keep a cheap watcher until finality. Card EXIT-08. Phase 29.
